node: Private-label coffee, tea, extracts, and beverage solutions for restaurants and foodservice
summary: Layer 1B expansion for the underfollowed B2B beverage-supply node finds a narrow US-listed universe. The clearest pure-play is Westrock Coffee, a small-cap integrated coffee, tea, and extract-solutions platform serving retailers, foodservice operators, and consumer brands. Farmer Brothers is highly node-relevant through foodservice/hospitality coffee, beverage, route-service and equipment-service exposure, but its sub-USD-300M size, prior asset sale, leverage/profitability risk, and customer-verification needs make it a speculative shadow candidate. TreeHouse Foods is a less pure but important adjacent private-label consolidator after buying Farmer Brothers' Northlake facility and non-direct-store-delivery business. Starbucks is included only as a high-attention reference/customer-context anchor, not as the intended alpha lane.
